selection.audience: Специалистам по качеству, пищевой безопасности и лабораторному контролю на пищевых производствах.
selection.use: Эксперимент помогает понять, как посторонние частицы могут менять результат испытания дезинфекции и почему результаты для одного способа обработки нельзя переносить на другой.
selection.limit: Лабораторное исследование двух видов бактерий и двух типов полимерных частиц при намеренно высокой концентрации пластика 1% (масса/объём). Оно не доказывает неэффективность рабочих дезсредств на конкретном производстве и не задаёт производственный режим обработки.
selection.triage: 9 full-text candidate abstracts; TypeSafe advisory labels, followed by source inspection.
selection.wordstat: The phrase микропластик дезинфекция returned HTTP 200 with an empty object; no count asserted.
selection.search_gap: Voronezh Yandex results included an automatically translated publisher abstract. No claim that no Russian coverage exists. Added value: complete scoped text, figure reading keys and offline files.

coverage.supplements: Separate author PDF/XLSX not translated; explicitly excluded from scope.

verification.review_limit: Direct source review found unsupported magnetron specificity and clarified exposure timing despite model PASS. Corrected before release. Two supplemental control attempts timed out; no reduction of source review or unattended-publication claim.
verification.pdf: 19 A4 pages; all five images embedded; figure pages inspected; no blank pages
verification.browser: 390px and 1280px: no overflow, all figures load, six source authors, download event, home/hub links and withdrawal note
verification.tests: 4 article-discovery tests, 4 snapshot-health tests, 2 source-identity regression tests; Astro build and discovery checks

related_correction.action: Retain URL with withdrawal notice; remove old unsupported summary and exclude from search feeds/recommendations.

monitoring.schedule: daily 09:20 Europe/Moscow, up to 2 minutes randomized delay
monitoring.limitation: Search results are not Webmaster index counts; no ranking improvement established.
